name: site_overview
description: How the site did over a period compared with the one before it: clicks, impressions, CTR, average position and the change in each. Covers the question 'how is my site doing'.

name: top
description: Top queries, pages, countries or devices for a period. Optionally narrowed to one country or device — 'top pages in Germany on mobile' is one call.

name: changes
description: What gained and what lost between this period and the one before it, with small rows filtered out. Answers 'what dropped in the last 28 days'.

name: find_opportunities
description: Queries ranking 5-20 with plenty of impressions but a click-through rate below what is typical at their position — where a title or snippet rewrite is worth the most clicks.

name: find_cannibalization
description: Queries where more than one page of the site is being shown, with how each page does on them.

name: page_queries
description: What searches a specific page is shown for.

name: brand_split
description: Branded versus non-branded search, split on the words supplied. The split is only as good as those terms: misspellings and the domain name catch more of what people type.

name: query
description: Direct query against Google's Search Analytics API, with the same dates, dimensions and filters it takes, passed through unchanged.

name: list_sites
description: Search Console properties this connection can read, from Google's Sites API. These are the exact strings the site argument takes.

name: inspect_url
description: Google's index status for one URL, as the URL Inspection API reports it: whether it is indexed, when it was last crawled, and which canonical Google chose.

name: list_sitemaps
description: Sitemaps submitted for the property and their status, from Google's Sitemaps API. Read-only: submitting is not possible with read access.
